content.short: Kado reduces onboarding and offboarding friction for customers, businesses, and merchants in crypto.
content.description: Kado provides web3 payments infrastructure for crypto-enabled web and mobile applications. Its on/off-ramp service can be integrated in under 10 minutes and enables users to buy or sell digital assets via ACH transfers, wire transfers, and Visa or Mastercard in more than 150 countries. Focused on accelerating global web3 adoption, Kado is backed by leading crypto investors Hashed, Race Capital, Collab+Currency, Republic Capital, and Circle Ventures.
content.meta: Kado provides web3 payments infrastructure and quick on/off-ramp services for crypto apps. Discover Kado and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
